body:
I am auditing and completing #780 at Bruno's request, including reconciliation
with #779. I am requesting Adler's explicit ownership agreement before editing
claimed shared functions. No claimed function has been changed.

The handoff's `rig_garments-claims.json` claims these exact functions reached by
the sorting migration:

- Compute `kernel/mod.rs`: `KernelBatch::dispatch` (Prepared dynamic offset /
  native port), and `KernelBatch::copy_buffer` (canonical byte length).
- GPU `compute/pass/mod.rs`: `ComputePass::record`.
- Creator `device_underlayer.rs`: `Fit::run` and `Fit::shells`.
- Armor `gpu/bracer.rs`: `DeviceBracer::record`.
- Shell `surface_contact.rs`: `SurfaceContacts::project_particles`.
- Creator `device_clearance.rs`: `ClearanceFit` and
  `DeviceWearer::record_clearance_fit`.
- Creator `device_limb.rs`: `DeviceWearer::record_fitted_limb`;
  `device_extremities.rs`: `DeviceWearer::record_mitten`;
  `device_chausses.rs`: `DeviceWearer::record_fitted_chausses`;
  `device_garment_tube.rs`: `DeviceWearer::record_fitted_tube`;
  `device_garment_skirt.rs`: `DeviceWearer::record_fitted_skirt`.

The first three dispatch/copy functions need canonical #779 `WorkgroupGrid`
receiving APIs and canonical `BufferByteLength` through the copy facade. Current
main also adds folded dispatch, pipeline preparation and post-submit callbacks;
these must survive. The other functions produce, retain or receive counts in
the unchanged normal/particle/underlayer graph. Typing only the final sort call
would leave that migration unfinished.

Proposed coordination: #780 consumes #779's canonical launch owners, preserving
sort/mesh/particle roles separately. Adler retains his whole-function ownership
and every physical, rig, byte-offset and concrete-error requirement. Please
explicitly agree how to integrate the dispatch/copy delta and count API changes
in the exact shared functions above, or provide Adler-owned integrated changes.
This is a request for coordinated integration, not a takeover or an assumed
partial-function transfer. No #774 family is being declared complete.

Correction: the original thirteen-lens inventory missed current-main hair and
spatial-hash sorting consumers. It is not clearance. Source repairs are frozen
until every lens covers the expanded producer and consumer graph. Additional
exact shared claims reached by the count/query and buffer-coherence work are:

- Armor `gpu/body.rs`: the claimed `BodySurface`/`GpuBody` fields and
  `GpuBody::new`; `Correspondence` fields and `record`/`read`/`finish`.
- Armor `gpu/mod.rs`: `ArmorGpu::nearest_points`, including actual collection
  admission and query-target construction.
- Creator `device_underlayer.rs`: claimed `fit`, `fit_async`, `Fit::record_skin`
  and readback fields/functions where typed source counts must propagate.
- Creator `device_underlayer/plan.rs`: `CutPlan::new`, which receives the
  checked cut layout rather than narrowed counts from independent fields.
- Creator `device_underlayer/shell.rs`: the claimed `LayerOffsets` and
  `Workspace::record_layers` receiving layout.

The repair needs canonical mesh vertex/triangle/corner populations, particle
populations and query populations through these producers and recipients.
Query target selection must retain whether its count belongs to all mesh
targets or to a candidate index list. Owned buffers must not be independently
replaceable in a way that invalidates retained population metadata. These
requirements complement the existing rig, physical and native-cause claims;
they do not transfer them or declare any #774 family complete.

Main is integrated locally. Independent unclaimed repairs are staged, including
#779's canonical launch definitions and checked parallel-scan layout. The
claimed shared function bodies remain untouched relative to current main.
Please provide explicit ownership agreement and integration contracts for the
whole shared functions, or Adler-owned integrated changes. No connected-family
push or hosted CI request will occur before source completion and agreed
reconciliation. No tests, cases, helpers or assertions are being added.


The expanded source trace also reaches these exact hair claims in
`rig_garments-claims.json`:

- Hair `gpu/grow.rs`: `GpuGroomer::grow_look` and `GpuGroomer::grow`.
- Hair `gpu/guides.rs`: the retained `Guides::Hairdo` variation/seed fields,
  `GpuGroomer::record_guide_roots`, `GpuGroomer::record_hairdo_guides` and
  `longest_guide`; `gpu/guides/packed.rs`: `HairdoUpload::new`.
- Hair `groom.rs`: retained `Groom.points` and `Groom::grow_while`;
  `look/groom.rs`: `Look::groom`.
- Hair `hairdo.rs`: `Hairdo::guides` and `guide_key`; `look.rs`:
  `Look::guides`; `parameters.rs`: the claimed signed32-to-full64 seed
  conversion contract.
- Creator `hair/groom.rs`: `GroomedHair::grow`.

Hair already owns `StrandCount` and `PointsPerStrand`; the sorting migration
must consume those owners through GPU groom construction, retained metadata,
strand permutation and its LOD/render/placement recipients. It must not create
competing GPU count types or erase quantities to primitives between internal
APIs. GPU layout admission must preserve authored max-two normalization,
resampling, the grow-only strand limit, the scalp's existing 16-bit vertex
limit, WGSL layouts and existing fixtures. Seed and RNG work remains Adler's
exact claim, including signed32 sign extension into the full64 guide seed.

Please explicitly agree how these whole claimed functions will provide the
required count/launch handoffs, or supply Adler-owned integrated changes.
There is no inferred ownership transfer and no shared-function body has been
edited. The expanded all-thirteen inventory is still in progress; this request
records the dependency early so independent source audit can continue.

Current-base and ownership update: main is now
`990430b77a9f63548ffcb642074185f61ddb3322` and includes merged #774 at
`13fc9dcc71ab879de364117e5462310673e43210`. This newer main has been fetched
for inspection; the local integration previously described above was against
`3a50b708381ad00c116445c2c999a49c3943088b`. No authored change to a claimed
shared function has been made, and merging #774 is not being treated as an
ownership transfer.

Two additional exact claims are reached by the source trace:

- Creator `surface_cut.rs`: `Plane/ConvexRegion/SourcePoint/SurfaceCut`,
  `SurfaceCut::new/borders`, `partition/clip/interpolate/dot/area_squared`
  and existing connected fixture adapters. Current main moves native point-ID
  construction into `surface_cut/assembly.rs`; its unchecked population
  conversion still precedes the underlayer plan. The complete connected
  layout needs coordination with the claimed surface-cut owner.
- Creator `device_fit.rs`: `Realization::upload`. Its directly reached
  `DeviceBody::get_or_upload` cache can return a previously uploaded body
  while the public realization supplies different host columns. Canonical
  count types alone cannot establish that source association.

Please explicitly identify which whole claimed functions and retained fields
#780 may change, or retain ownership and provide integrated changes with their
final APIs and revision. This supplements the existing dispatch, byte,
mesh/query/particle and hair requests above; it does not take over rig,
geometry, physical, seed or native-error work. Source repairs remain frozen
while the complete initial thirteen-lens inventory and current-main
reconciliation are unfinished.
